_comment: Summary offload copy (T11.3db, docs/sync.md section 10). writers: the label of each writer kind presence carries. unavailable: the banner when this computer wrote the summary because the chosen computer was not asked, by reason; {device} (always at the start of a sentence) is the chosen computer's name. written_here: the warning of a summary this computer wrote after asking, by reason; {device} as above. waiting: the meeting's line while a request is open. unnamed: {device} at the start of a sentence for a computer whose name is not known; unnamed_inline: the same inside a sentence (waiting). Pinned to the desktop's offload copy by its tests and read by the UI mock. Shipped with the app: public copy only.

unavailable.sync_off: Sync is off, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.unreachable: The sync server could not be reached, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.offline: {device} is not online, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.not_offering: {device} no longer writes summaries for your other computers, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.no_writer: {device} has no summary writer set up, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.recording: {device} is recording a meeting, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.no_final_transcript: This meeting has no final transcript to send, so this computer wrote the summary.
unavailable.not_asked: {device} could not be asked, so this computer wrote the summary.

written_here.not_claimed: {device} did not answer, so this computer wrote the summary.
written_here.helper_stale: {device} went offline before it finished, so this computer wrote the summary.
written_here.declined: {device} could not write the summary, so this computer wrote it.
written_here.withdrawn: {device} did not write the summary, so this computer wrote it.

waiting: Waiting for {device} to write the summary.
